newsitem.title: USA: Brothers reaches settlement, expects charge.
newsitem.headline: Brothers reaches settlement, expects charge.

text.p: Brothers Gourmet Coffees Inc said Friday that it had reached an agreement in principle to settle shareholder lawsuits, adding that it expected a $5.5 million charge to third quarter 1996 earnings as a result.

In a release Friday, Brothers said the settlement will include about $5.5 million worth of its freely tradeable common stock and a cash payment -- none of which is being provided by the company -- of $3 million.
Brothers said it wanted to settle all of the claims against the company and other defendants in the federal securities law class action suit and state law derivative action filed in 1995.

While the Chief Executive Officer, Donald Breen, said in the release that he continues "to believe that the lawsuits are without merit," he said he feels it is "in the best interests of the company and the stockholders to settle" and turn attention to the future.

Brothers said in an earlier release that it would report its third quarter 1996 results on November 7. The $5.5 million one-time, non-cash charge to earnings for the shares of stock issued in the settlement will be included in the third quarter, it said Friday.
